notes: 1.3.35: the picture judge (from 1.3.34: a small vision model, Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, describes one frame of every stock candidate in words before the download and the episode's reject rules judge the words; pools fetched before it are judged once on the next Run; people are footage when the subject is people) and, new here, an update keeps your settings: INSTALL.bat runs once after every update, and it now merges config.json instead of rewriting it, so the voice you kept by ear, your episodes folder, a pinned engine count and your own tunables survive every update.
